## Task 2

- n = 50
- every week
- Movement = 0, 1, 2
- me = 1

```{r}
source('unpack_functions.R')


load('/u/home/j/jasenzz/Graphical_Cox_Process/GMpp-main/spike_data/Brain_Region.RData')


n <- 50   
movements <- c(0, 1, 2) # movement is either both (0) resting (1) or moving (2)
VR <- 0
epoch_or_week <- 'week'
ew_nums <- c(17:29, 31, 33, 35, 38)
min_edges <- 1

first_root <- "/u/home/j/jasenzz/Graphical_Cox_Process/GMpp-main/results_alzheimers/week_move_2"
folder_names <- list.files(path = first_root, full.names = TRUE)
folder_params <- extract_pieces(folder_names)

summary_df <- data.frame()
first <- T

for(i in 1:length(folder_names)){ # for each folder
  
  folder_i <- folder_names[i]
  
  n <- folder_params$replicate[i]
  movement <- folder_params$movement[i]
  VR <- folder_params$VR[i]
  ew_num <- folder_params$ew_num[i]
  
  file_names <- list.files(path = folder_i, full.names = TRUE) # get the .rda file names within each folder
  
  mouse_IDs <- extract_pieces2(file_names) # get the mouse names
  
  for(j in 1:length(file_names)){ # for each mouse
    result_ij <- unpack_tabular_summary(n, movement, VR, epoch_or_week, ew_num, mouse_IDs[j], min_edges, df_brain_region, file_names[j])
    
    summary_df <- rbind(summary_df, result_ij)
  }
   
  
}

summary_df[-which(names(summary_df) == "mouse_ID")] <- lapply(summary_df[-which(names(summary_df) == "mouse_ID")], as.numeric)
summary_df$mouse_ID <- factor(summary_df$mouse_ID)

movement_factor <- rep('Running', nrow(summary_df))
movement_factor[summary_df$movement == 0] <- 'Both'
movement_factor[summary_df$movement == 1] <- 'Resting'
movement_factor <- factor(movement_factor, levels = c('Both', 'Resting', 'Running'))
summary_df$movement_factor <- movement_factor

## graphing the summary statistics over time

# average degree over time, stratified by mouse and movement

mice_strains2 <- c(
  "Tau1" = "lightcoral",
  "Tau2" = "red",
  "Tau3" = "darkred",
  "WT1" = "lightgreen",
  "WT2" = "green",
  "WT3" = "darkgreen"
)

g1 <- ggplot() + 
  geom_point(data = summary_df, aes(x = ew_num, y = avg_deg, color = mouse_ID)) + 
  geom_line(data = summary_df, aes(x = ew_num, y = avg_deg, color = mouse_ID)) + 
  facet_wrap(~ movement_factor) + 
  ylab('Average Degree') + 
  xlab('Age (Weeks)') + 
  theme_bw() + 
  scale_color_manual(values = mice_strains2)

# proportion of non-singletons

summary_df$pct_non_singletons <- 100 * summary_df$num_con_verts/summary_df$num_candidates

g2 <- ggplot() + 
  geom_point(data = summary_df, aes(x = ew_num, y = pct_non_singletons, color = mouse_ID)) + 
  geom_line(data = summary_df, aes(x = ew_num, y = pct_non_singletons, color = mouse_ID)) + 
  facet_wrap(~ movement_factor) + 
  ylab('Percentage of non-Singletons') + 
  xlab('Age (Weeks)') + 
  theme_bw() + 
  scale_color_manual(values = mice_strains2)

# proportion of inter-region connections

summary_df$pct_inter_region_edge <- 100 * summary_df$num_HE_edges/summary_df$num_edges

g3 <- ggplot() + 
  geom_point(data = summary_df, aes(x = ew_num, y = pct_inter_region_edge, color = mouse_ID)) + 
  geom_line(data = summary_df, aes(x = ew_num, y = pct_inter_region_edge, color = mouse_ID)) + 
  facet_wrap(~ movement_factor) + 
  ylab('Percentage of Inter-Region Edges') + 
  xlab('Age (Weeks)') + 
  theme_bw() + 
  scale_color_manual(values = mice_strains2)

# 4) proportion of candidate neurons out of total neurons

summary_df$pct_candidate_neurons <- 100 * summary_df$num_candidates/summary_df$num_neurons

g4 <- ggplot() + 
  geom_point(data = summary_df, aes(x = ew_num, y = pct_candidate_neurons, color = mouse_ID)) + 
  geom_line(data = summary_df, aes(x = ew_num, y = pct_candidate_neurons, color = mouse_ID)) + 
  facet_wrap(~ movement_factor) + 
  ylab('Percentage of non-discarded Neurons') + 
  xlab('Age (Weeks)') + 
  ylim(c(0, 100)) + 
  theme_bw() + 
  scale_color_manual(values = mice_strains2)
```
